title: Claude Node Input Parameters
description: Resolved per-item input to the Claude n8n node, after n8n expression evaluation. This is the contract the runtime layer (subprocess.runner.ts) consumes; it is not the n8n INodeProperties declaration itself.

prompt.description: The text prompt to send to Claude. MUST be a non-empty string after trim. n8n expressions yielding non-string values are coerced via String() upstream of this contract.

timeoutSeconds.description: Wall-clock timeout for the CLI subprocess. On expiry, SIGTERM is sent; if the process does not exit within 5 seconds, SIGKILL is sent.

cliBinaryName.description: Name of the CLI binary to spawn. Resolved against PATH by the OS. The pattern restricts characters to defend against the override field itself becoming an injection vector.

itemIndex.description: Zero-based index of the input item being processed. Used for per-item error attribution; supplied by n8n's runtime.
